# Test-scenario accounts

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/seed-test-scenarios.ts — run `pnpm seed:scenarios` to rebuild. -->

_Last seeded: 2026-08-30 against the database in `DATABASE_URL`._

Every account shares one login password and one vault passphrase. Those, plus each account's CLI token / organization Enrollment Secret / invite link, are generated per seed run and written to **`docs/test-scenarios.local.md`** (git-ignored) — they are also printed to the console by `pnpm seed:scenarios`. Set `SEED_ACCOUNT_PASSWORD` / `SEED_VAULT_PASSPHRASE` to pin stable values.

> The vault passphrase unlocks the client-side master key. Each account still has its own random KDF salt, so the derived keys differ.

## Scenario map

| Email | Scenario | What it exercises |
|---|---|---|
| `free-newcomer@nvault.test` | Free · brand-new account | Empty Free account — no vault keypair, no projects, one browser session. |
| `free-active@nvault.test` | Free · normal usage | Healthy Free account well under every cap — 2 projects, one file with version history. |
| `free-projects-maxed@nvault.test` | Free · at personal-project cap | Free account holding exactly 3 personal projects — creating a 4th must 402. |
| `free-versions-maxed@nvault.test` | Free · at file version-history cap | Free account with a file at its 2-version lifetime cap — next upload AND restore must 402; history list is trimmed + flagged `capped`. |
| `free-devices-maxed@nvault.test` | Free · at device (browser-session) cap | Free account with 2 active browser sessions — a 3rd sign-in evicts the least-recently-used one (its access token then 401s). |
| `free-cli@nvault.test` | Free · CLI token in use | Free account that has issued its 1 allowed CLI Personal Access Token — a 2nd create must 409 until this one is revoked. |
| `pro-active@nvault.test` | Pro · active subscription | Paid Pro account — personal-project cap lifted, 5 devices / 5 CLI tokens, unlimited version history. |
| `pro-past-due@nvault.test` | Pro · payment failed (dunning) | Pro subscription in PAST_DUE — Polar is retrying the charge; entitlement is still granted during the dunning window. |
| `pro-canceled@nvault.test` | Pro · canceled (over cap, grandfathered) | Pro subscription CANCELED while holding 5 projects — nothing is deleted, but the Free cap is reinstated so no new personal project can be created. |
| `pro-pending@nvault.test` | Pro · checkout started, never paid | A PENDING Pro subscription row (checkout opened, payment never completed) — no entitlement; behaves exactly like Free. Also the target of the pending-subscription purge cron. |
| `org-owner@nvault.test` | Team · org OWNER (active, STARTER) | Owner + billing manager of an ACTIVE Team org on the STARTER tier (10-member cap). 2 shared org projects. |
| `org-admin@nvault.test` | Team · org ADMIN (enrolled) | ADMIN of Acme — can manage members/invites, create/delete org projects and rotate the Org Key, but cannot touch billing or delete the org. |
| `org-member@nvault.test` | Team · org MEMBER (enrolled) | Regular MEMBER of Acme — read/write files in every org project, no admin powers. |
| `org-invited@nvault.test` | Team · org member, accepted but NOT enrolled | Accepted the invite (membership row exists) but has not entered the Enrollment Secret yet — holds no Org Key, so Acme's projects are invisible. |
| `org-pending-invite@nvault.test` | Team · outstanding (un-accepted) invite | Account exists with a keypair; Acme has sent a MEMBER invite that has not been accepted. Use the token to exercise the accept flow. |
| `org-owner-pending@nvault.test` | Team · org OWNER, PENDING_PAYMENT | Created an org but never completed Team checkout — the org is unusable (every org read/write 402s) and shows the checkout CTA. Purged by the cron after 7 days. |
| `org-owner-suspended@nvault.test` | Team · org OWNER, SUSPENDED | Team subscription lapsed (PAST_DUE) → org is read-only: members can still pull existing secrets, but every write 402s until the owner renews. |
| `org-owner-growth@nvault.test` | Team · org OWNER (active, GROWTH) | ACTIVE Team org on the GROWTH tier (25-member cap) — for exercising tier limits, upgrades and guarded downgrades. |
| `outsider@nvault.test` | Isolation · unrelated account | A plain account that is not a member of any organization and owns no projects — use it to prove ID-manipulation access to other users' / orgs' resources returns 404, never 403. |

## Details

### `free-newcomer@nvault.test` — Free · brand-new account

Empty Free account — no vault keypair, no projects, one browser session.

- Free plan (no subscription row)
- No RSA keypair yet (cannot create/join an organization)
- 0 projects — baseline for first-run / empty-state UI

### `free-active@nvault.test` — Free · normal usage

Healthy Free account well under every cap — 2 projects, one file with version history.

- Free plan
- RSA keypair provisioned
- 2 / 3 personal projects; `.env` in portfolio-site has 2 versions (cap is 2 — at the limit)

### `free-projects-maxed@nvault.test` — Free · at personal-project cap

Free account holding exactly 3 personal projects — creating a 4th must 402.

- Free plan
- 3 / 3 personal projects (FREE_LIMITS.maxPersonalProjects)
- Expected: POST /projects → 402 'Upgrade to Pro'

### `free-versions-maxed@nvault.test` — Free · at file version-history cap

Free account with a file at its 2-version lifetime cap — next upload AND restore must 402; history list is trimmed + flagged `capped`.

- Free plan
- 1 project `web-app`; `.env` has versionsCreated = 2 (FREE_LIMITS.maxVersionsPerFile)
- Expected: another upload of `.env` → 402; restore of any version → 402

### `free-devices-maxed@nvault.test` — Free · at device (browser-session) cap

Free account with 2 active browser sessions — a 3rd sign-in evicts the least-recently-used one (its access token then 401s).

- Free plan
- 2 / 2 active browser sessions (FREE_LIMITS.maxBrowserSessions)
- Expected: 3rd login succeeds but revokes the oldest session

### `free-cli@nvault.test` — Free · CLI token in use

Free account that has issued its 1 allowed CLI Personal Access Token — a 2nd create must 409 until this one is revoked.

- Free plan
- 1 / 1 active CLI token (FREE_LIMITS.maxCliTokens)
- 1 personal project the CLI can pull
- Secrets (CLI token (evk_…, shown once — real, works against the API)): see `docs/test-scenarios.local.md`

### `pro-active@nvault.test` — Pro · active subscription

Paid Pro account — personal-project cap lifted, 5 devices / 5 CLI tokens, unlimited version history.

- Subscription: plan PRO, status ACTIVE
- 5 personal projects (past the Free cap of 3); each `.env` has 3 versions
- 2 / 5 active CLI tokens
- Secrets (CLI token (evk_…, shown once)): see `docs/test-scenarios.local.md`

### `pro-past-due@nvault.test` — Pro · payment failed (dunning)

Pro subscription in PAST_DUE — Polar is retrying the charge; entitlement is still granted during the dunning window.

- Subscription: plan PRO, status PAST_DUE
- 4 personal projects (still over the Free cap — entitlement holds)
- Expected: `userHasActivePro` → true (statusGrantsEntitlement)

### `pro-canceled@nvault.test` — Pro · canceled (over cap, grandfathered)

Pro subscription CANCELED while holding 5 projects — nothing is deleted, but the Free cap is reinstated so no new personal project can be created.

- Subscription: plan PRO, status CANCELED
- 5 personal projects retained (limits are never retroactive)
- Expected: POST /projects → 402; existing projects fully usable

### `pro-pending@nvault.test` — Pro · checkout started, never paid

A PENDING Pro subscription row (checkout opened, payment never completed) — no entitlement; behaves exactly like Free. Also the target of the pending-subscription purge cron.

- Subscription: plan PRO, status PENDING
- 3 / 3 personal projects — still Free-capped
- Expected: `userHasActivePro` → false

### `org-owner@nvault.test` — Team · org OWNER (active, STARTER)

Owner + billing manager of an ACTIVE Team org on the STARTER tier (10-member cap). 2 shared org projects.

- Org `acme-corp` — status ACTIVE, subscription TEAM/ACTIVE, tier STARTER
- Membership: OWNER, status ACTIVE (holds a wrapped Org Key)
- Can open the billing portal, change tier, transfer ownership, rotate the Org Key
- Secrets (Organization Enrollment Secret (share out-of-band with invitees)): see `docs/test-scenarios.local.md`

### `org-admin@nvault.test` — Team · org ADMIN (enrolled)

ADMIN of Acme — can manage members/invites, create/delete org projects and rotate the Org Key, but cannot touch billing or delete the org.

- Membership in `acme-corp`: ADMIN, status ACTIVE
- Enrolled via the Enrollment Secret — can decrypt every Acme project
- Expected: billing portal / change-tier / delete-org → 403

### `org-member@nvault.test` — Team · org MEMBER (enrolled)

Regular MEMBER of Acme — read/write files in every org project, no admin powers.

- Membership in `acme-corp`: MEMBER, status ACTIVE
- Enrolled — shared org projects appear in their project list and decrypt end-to-end
- Expected: create invite / create org project → 403

### `org-invited@nvault.test` — Team · org member, accepted but NOT enrolled

Accepted the invite (membership row exists) but has not entered the Enrollment Secret yet — holds no Org Key, so Acme's projects are invisible.

- Membership in `acme-corp`: MEMBER, status INVITED
- `wrappedOrgKeyCiphertext` is null; not in the roster
- Expected: org projects hidden from /projects; enroll with the secret flips to ACTIVE

### `org-pending-invite@nvault.test` — Team · outstanding (un-accepted) invite

Account exists with a keypair; Acme has sent a MEMBER invite that has not been accepted. Use the token to exercise the accept flow.

- No membership row yet — one pending OrganizationInvite for this email on `acme-corp`
- Invite expires 7 days after seeding
- Expected: POST /invites/accept with a *different* account → 403; correct account → INVITED membership
- Secrets (Invite token (oiv_…, single-use), Enrollment Secret for after accepting): see `docs/test-scenarios.local.md`

### `org-owner-pending@nvault.test` — Team · org OWNER, PENDING_PAYMENT

Created an org but never completed Team checkout — the org is unusable (every org read/write 402s) and shows the checkout CTA. Purged by the cron after 7 days.

- Org `beta-llc` — status PENDING_PAYMENT, subscription TEAM/PENDING
- Membership: OWNER, status ACTIVE (but org gate blocks everything)
- Expected: create project / invite in this org → 402; GET billing → 200 with CTA
- Secrets (Organization Enrollment Secret): see `docs/test-scenarios.local.md`

### `org-owner-suspended@nvault.test` — Team · org OWNER, SUSPENDED

Team subscription lapsed (PAST_DUE) → org is read-only: members can still pull existing secrets, but every write 402s until the owner renews.

- Org `gamma-industries` — status SUSPENDED, subscription TEAM/PAST_DUE
- 1 pre-existing org project `monolith` with a file (still readable)
- Expected: GET org project files → 200; upload / create project → 402
- Secrets (Organization Enrollment Secret): see `docs/test-scenarios.local.md`

### `org-owner-growth@nvault.test` — Team · org OWNER (active, GROWTH)

ACTIVE Team org on the GROWTH tier (25-member cap) — for exercising tier limits, upgrades and guarded downgrades.

- Org `delta-group` — status ACTIVE, subscription TEAM/ACTIVE, tier GROWTH
- Membership: OWNER, status ACTIVE
- Expected: invites allowed up to 25 seats; downgrade to STARTER refused while > 10 seats
- Secrets (Organization Enrollment Secret): see `docs/test-scenarios.local.md`

### `outsider@nvault.test` — Isolation · unrelated account

A plain account that is not a member of any organization and owns no projects — use it to prove ID-manipulation access to other users' / orgs' resources returns 404, never 403.

- Free plan, RSA keypair provisioned, 0 projects, 0 memberships
- Expected: GET another user's project / any org by id → 404
